reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Getting to ZERO Malaria Deaths in Zimbabwe: scaling up effective malaria control interventions in Zimbabwe - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Malaria, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: To reduce Malaria deaths to near zero by 2017. To reduce malaria incidence from 22/1000 in 2012 to 10/1000 in 2017. The objectives of this program are: To detect 100% of epidemics within one week of onset and effectively manage them within two weeks of detection. To ensure access to prompt and appropriate management of all malaria cases within 24 hours of onset of symptoms by 2017. To ensure universal access of the population at risk to effective and appropriate malaria prevention interventions by 2017. To expand districts implementing pre-elimination activities from 7 to 20 by 2017. To increase utilisation of correct malaria prevention and control measures to at least 80% by 2017
